phrases.latin: Vestītī, Theodōrō adminiculum tenente gradūsque, ut prīdiē, numerante, per scālās in īmum tabulātum dēscendērunt.
phrases.english: Once dressed, they went downstairs, Theo holding the banister and counting the steps as he had the day before.
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus
